# istio_workload_entry (Resource)

Manages an Istio WorkloadEntry resource. WorkloadEntries describe non-Kubernetes workloads (VMs, bare metal) being onboarded into the mesh.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "istio_workload_entry" "vm" {
  manifest = jsonencode({
    apiVersion = "networking.istio.io/v1"
    kind       = "WorkloadEntry"
    metadata = {
      name      = "my-vm"
      namespace = "default"
    }
    spec = {
      address        = "10.0.0.50"
      serviceAccount = "my-app-sa"
      labels = {
        app     = "my-app"
        version = "v1"
      }
    }
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `manifest` (String) Full WorkloadEntry manifest as a JSON string. Must include `apiVersion`, `kind`, `metadata.name`, and `metadata.namespace`. The `apiVersion` in the manifest determines which API version is used (e.g. `networking.istio.io/v1` or an older version like `v1beta1`). Sensitive fields (tokens, keys, passwords, etc.) are redacted to "(redacted)" in state after read.

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Resource identifier in the format `namespace/name` (or `name` for cluster-scoped resources).
